mapper.select: SELECT company_id FROM company WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY company_id

SELECT ea.employee_id AS employeeId, ea.employment_period_id AS employmentPeriodId, employee.company_id AS companyId FROM employment_assignment ea JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = ea.employee_id WHERE employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND ea.current_version_marker = 1 AND ea.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ea.effective_from <= #{at} AND (ea.effective_to IS NULL OR ea.effective_to > #{at})

SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, kind AS kind, SUM(recognized_minutes) AS recognizedMinutes FROM ( SELECT fact.employee_id, fact.oa_attendance_document_id, CASE WHEN fact.document_type = 'LEAVE' AND ( fact.leave_type_code IN ('ANNUAL', 'ANNUAL_LEAVE') OR fact.leave_type_code LIKE '%年假%' ) THEN 'ANNUAL' WHEN fact.document_type = 'TIME_OFF' THEN 'TIME_OFF' WHEN fact.document_type = 'OVERTIME' AND ( fact.leave_type_code LIKE '%COMPENSATORY%' OR fact.leave_type_code LIKE '%TIME_OFF%' OR fact.leave_type_code LIKE '%调休%' OR context.overtime_type IN ( 'COMPENSATORY', 'TIME_OFF_IN_LIEU') ) THEN 'COMPENSATORY_OT' ELSE NULL END AS kind, MAX(fact.recognized_minutes) AS recognized_minutes FROM attendance_report_oa_fact fact JOIN ( SELECT attendance_report_projection_id FROM ( SELECT attendance_report_projection_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY period_start, period_end_exclusive ORDER BY published_at DESC, attendance_report_projection_id DESC ) AS rn FROM attendance_report_projection WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND formula_catalog_version = 'FULL_CALCULATION_OA_FORM_HOURS_V8' AND published_at <= #{asOf} ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) latest_pin ON latest_pin.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id JOIN oa_attendance_document document ON document.oa_attendance_document_id = fact.oa_attendance_document_id LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_document_context context ON context.oa_attendance_document_id = fact.oa_attendance_document_id WHERE fact.source_status IN ('APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED') AND COALESCE(fact.interval_start, fact.point_instant) >= #{yearStart} AND COALESCE(fact.interval_start, fact.point_instant) < #{yearEndExclusive} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_report_oa_evidence_exclusion excl WHERE excl.oa_attendance_document_id = document.oa_attendance_document_id AND excl.attendance_source_id = document.attendance_source_id AND excl.source_business_key = document.source_business_key AND excl.source_version = document.source_version AND excl.employee_id = fact.employee_id AND excl.company_id = #{companyId} AND excl.knowledge_at <= #{asOf} AND (excl.reversed_at IS NULL OR excl.reversed_at > #{asOf}) ) GROUP BY fact.employee_id, fact.oa_attendance_document_id, kind ) documents WHERE kind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY employee_id, kind

SELECT entry.time_account_ledger_entry_id AS entryId, entry.entry_type AS entryType, entry.amount_hours AS amountHours FROM time_account_ledger_entry entry WHERE entry.time_account_id = #{accountId} AND entry.source_type = 'OA_SYNC' AND entry.entry_type IN ('USE', 'OVERTIME_CREDIT') AND entry.business_date >= #{yearStart} AND entry.business_date >= '2026-09-19' AND entry.business_date < #{yearEndExclusive} AND ( entry.request_id LIKE 'oa-sync:%' OR entry.request_id LIKE 'oa-sync-rev:%' OR entry.request_id LIKE 'oa-sync-fix-%' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM time_account_ledger_entry reversal WHERE reversal.reversal_of_entry_id = entry.time_account_ledger_entry_id )

SELECT entry.time_account_id AS accountId, entry.time_account_ledger_entry_id AS entryId, entry.entry_type AS entryType, entry.amount_hours AS amountHours FROM time_account_ledger_entry entry JOIN time_account ta ON ta.time_account_id = entry.time_account_id JOIN employee emp ON emp.employee_id = ta.employee_id WHERE emp.company_id = #{companyId} AND entry.source_type = 'OA_SYNC' AND entry.entry_type IN ('USE', 'OVERTIME_CREDIT') AND entry.business_date >= #{yearStart} AND entry.business_date >= '2026-09-19' AND entry.business_date < #{yearEndExclusive} AND ( entry.request_id LIKE 'oa-sync:%' OR entry.request_id LIKE 'oa-sync-rev:%' OR entry.request_id LIKE 'oa-sync-fix-%' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM time_account_ledger_entry reversal WHERE reversal.reversal_of_entry_id = entry.time_account_ledger_entry_id )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO time_account_ledger_entry ( time_account_ledger_entry_id, time_account_id, sequence_no, entry_type, amount_hours, source_type, source_id, business_date, effective_from, expires_on, policy_version_id, period_version_id, close_snapshot_id, request_id, reversal_of_entry_id, actor_id, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{entryId}, #{accountId}, #{sequenceNo}, 'REVERSAL', #{amountHours}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{businessDate}, #{businessDate}, NULL, #{policyVersionId}, NULL, NULL, #{requestId}, #{reversalOfEntryId}, #{actorId}, #{occurredAt} )
